title: Duecare harness chat — wheels
subtitle: v3.17 omni harness chat: 5 toggles + 4 grade modes + 9 model variants
description: v3.17 / chat-package 0.2.2 (2026-05-07) — 21-dim rubric, use-case-aware analog prompt classifier (multi-lingual: en/tl/id/ne/bn/my/ar/es/vi/si/ta/ur), curator-block JSON governance, judge → evaluator rename, browser model picker with loader logs. v0.2.2 UI fix: removed a literal HTML-tag fragment from a JS comment that was tripping a script-tag terminator under proxy chains; the empty-state Pick-a-model CTA, clickable badge, and About modal are now reliable. GREP rule set now ships 111 rules across 16 categories, including v3.17 digital-era additions for QR/mobile-wallet payment plans, side-letter two-contract deception, and digital credential-vault debt control. RAG corpus now ships 35 docs, including digital fee collection and side-letter deception briefs. Bundled wheels: duecare-llm-chat, duecare-llm-core, duecare-llm-models. Single CORE entry point: one configurable interface wiring every harness layer + 9 model variants (Gemma 4 E2B / E4B / 26B-A4B / 31B / 2 abliterated jailbroken / 3 cloud BYOK routes). Updates land here - bump this dataset version to refresh attached notebooks.
